message.content:
Los Angeles enjoys a mild winter. In December the city’s average daily temperatures hover around:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Average high | ≈ 20 °C (≈ 68 °F) |
| Average low | ≈ 10 °C (≈ 50 °F) |
| Mean (average of highs & lows) | ≈ 15 °C (≈ 59 °F) |

So you can expect daytime temperatures in the mid‑60s °F (around 18–21 °C) and nighttime lows in the lower 40s °F (≈ 8–12 °C).
